basic_details.job_title: TMC Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Radio Diagnosis Posts
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) has announced 3 vacancies for Fellow in Radio Diagnosis posts, comprising One Year TMC Fellow in Cancer Imaging, One Year TMC Fellow in Breast Imaging, and One Year TMC Fellow in Head & Neck and Neuro-Onco Imaging. This contract engagement is a tenured based position for a fixed period up to one year with a pay of Rs. 1,33,623. Candidates must hold an MD/DNB (Radio-Diagnosis) or Equivalent PG Degree recognized by NMC. Eligible applicants can apply online through the website by paying a fee of Rs. 300 on or before 31 October 2026. The selection process involves an MCQ

content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 3 posts in the Department of Radio Diagnosis at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the TMC Fellow in Radio Diagnosis posts must possess an MD/DNB (Radio-Diagnosis) or an equivalent Postgraduate Degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). All undergraduate, postgraduate, and super-specialty degrees must be recognized by the NMC, and selected candidates must register with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council, as applicable. The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 31.10.2026. Age relaxation is applicable as follows: SC/ST candidates: 5 years OBC candidates: 3 years Person with Disabilities (PwD): 10 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected fellows will be appointed on a tenured-based position for a fixed period of up to one year. They will be offered a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,33,623/- (Rupees One Lakh Thirty-Three Thousand Six Hundred Twenty-Three only). A security/caution deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- is applicable for fellows.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Fellow in Radio Diagnosis
content_sections.text: Access the online application portal via the official Tata Memorial Centre website link. Complete the online application form with all required details and upload necessary documents including proof of date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste/category, disability certificate, and NOC if employed. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 300/- using a Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI. Submit the online application form on or before 31.10.2026 up to 05:30 p.m. (IST). Note that hard copies of the application form are not required to be submitted or sent to the centre.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process includes an MCQ Examination, which may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting purposes at the discretion of the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, followed by an Interview. No TA/DA will be admissible to candidates appearing for the MCQ test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The advertised posts are tenured-based positions for a fixed period of up to one year.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation and what is the extent?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is available up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, and 10 years for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates may be shortlisted through an MCQ examination conducted before the interview, at the discretion of the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be attached or provided during the process?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit documentary evidence for date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste/category, disability certificate, and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently employed with a government or government-related organization.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, a separate application must be submitted for each post if applying for multiple positions.
